PLAN "Couch-to-5K for EIA (12 weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete 5K run"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk-Run Intro":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x1..1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Easy Aerobic":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          continuous_walk 1x20m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Progressive Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 8x1..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Increase Run Time":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x2..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Easy Aerobic":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          continuous_walk 1x22m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 32m "Controlled Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x2..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 34m "Longer Run Segments":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x3..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 7m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x18m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 4m
      DAY Friday training 34m "Interval Focus":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x3..1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 7m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 36m "Consolidation":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 4x4..1 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Steady Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x25m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 2m
      DAY Friday training 36m "Endurance Builder":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 4x4..1 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 8m

  PHASE "Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Increase Continuous Running":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x28m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Recovery + Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x20m rpe 6
          strides 6x20..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 4m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Long Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 4x6..1 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Solid Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x32m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Recovery + Mobility":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x22m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 42m "Threshold Practice (Controlled)":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          tempo_run 3x6..1 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 44m "Longer Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x36m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Recovery + Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x22m rpe 5
          strides 6x20..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 6m
      DAY Friday training 44m "Interval Progression":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 5x5..1 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 46m "Steady Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x40m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x24m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 4m
      DAY Friday training 48m "Race Pace Familiarisation":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          tempo_run 3x8..1 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m

  PHASE "Sharpen & Race Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Long Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x45m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Recovery + Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x24m rpe 5
          strides 8x20..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Controlled Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 4x8..1 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Race Pace Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          tempo_run 2x12..1 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 36m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x26m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 2m
      DAY Friday training 42m "Short Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 6x3..1 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 36m "Taper Start":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x28m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Sharp Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x18m rpe 5
          strides 6x20..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 4m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Easy Shakeout":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x10m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Pre-Race Easy":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x10m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          walking_mobility 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Very Easy":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 1x12m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 3m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "5K Race Day":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          race_5k 1x5k rpe 8
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m

NOTES
  - Prioritise inhaler use: use SABA before warmup per GP guidance if normally required.
  - Avoid high-intensity work in very cold air; perform sessions indoors or with extra warmup in cold conditions.
  - If asthma symptoms worsen, stop and follow GP advice.
